content.text:
Your study group wiki is live at:

**https://notes-wiki.bench-20260919-2334.kitbash.zyx.tw**

Share that link with the group. Anyone who opens it can:
- See a list of all pages, who wrote them, and when they were last updated
- Click **New page** to write notes in Markdown (title + your name + content)
- Click any page to read it rendered, or **Edit**/**Delete** it

It's a single container (Python stdlib server, no framework) with pages stored as JSON on a persistent mount (`notes-wiki-data`), so content survives restarts/redeploys. Markdown is rendered server-side and sanitized before being sent to browsers, so pasted HTML/script tags can't run as stored XSS against other members.

There's no login — anyone with the link can read and write, matching a casual study-group use case. Let me know if you'd like a shared password, per-person accounts, or page history/versioning added.
